items.title: What to do with totally implantable venous access ports when treatment completed – Full Text
items.summary: "Among 1406 patients, the 12-month cumulative incidence was 34.3% (95% confidence interval [CI], 31.4-37.1) for elective removal, 10.1% (95% CI, 8.2-11.9) for reactivation, 4.1% (95% CI, 3.0-5.3) for complication-related removal, and 1.0% (95% CI, 0.5-1.6) for network-documented death" Fan et al (2026).

items.title: IV pump availability linked to hospital bed numbers
items.summary: "Pump ownership was strongly correlated with the number of beds for both infusion and syringe pumps. Pumps per bed ranged from 0.26 to 0.48 for infusion pumps and from 0.16 to 0.45 for syringe pumps" Imada et al (2026).

items.title: PICC placement using bedside ultrasound in NICU
items.summary: "Implementation of a POCUS-guided PICC protocol improved confirmation efficiency and reduced reliance on multiple radiographs" Caddell et al (2026).

items.title: Targeted infusion pump calibration method
items.summary: "Establishing a measurement and acceptance system based on nursing needs can effectively eliminate the risks of clinical use of infusion pumps and has important practical significance for improving the level of nursing safety management" Li et al (2026).

items.title: Complicated urinary tract infections managed in a hospital-at-home programme – Full Text
items.summary: "In this single-centre, uncontrolled descriptive cohort, cUTI managed through HaH/OPAT was associated with high clinical cure and low unplanned transfer, despite a substantial burden of ESBL-producing organisms and other resistance-mechanism-positive isolates" Pelari-Mici et al (2026).

items.title: Management of home medical equipment – Full Text
items.summary: "This study aims to elucidate the relationship between equipment malfunctions and management practices at visiting nursing stations (stations), as well as to assess the perceived need for CEs" Hamasaka et al (2026).
